description: Use this when the user has confirmed a plan_dependency plan for a site already monitored. Returns the dependency created, with its id and how it is watched. Spends one monitor. Safe to repeat: the same plan id returns the first result. Not for a dependency inside a plan_site plan: create_site adds those with the site.

confirm.description: The plan's confirm sentence, exactly as returned; show it to the user first.
